entries.speaker: Narrator

entries.dialogueText: Once more, I took my seat next to Hugo in the middle of the House of Delegates.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "My uncle seemed to be in a grim moo..."
entries.dialogueText: My uncle seemed to be in a grim mood today. He watched with agitation as the representatives began filing into the room.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Are you sure it's a good idea to b..."
entries.dialogueText: "Are you sure it's a good idea to be here today, Your Majesty? You have every right to shutter the House of Delegates while the war is ongoing."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "My uncle watched with agitation as..."
entries.dialogueText: My uncle watched with agitation as the representatives began filing into the room.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Your first visit to the House of D..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your first visit to the House of Delegates since the RPP took over as majority party."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""And give my enemies in ATO more am..."
entries.dialogueText: "And give my enemies in ATO more ammunition against me? Never."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "I can't blindly fight a war without knowing what's going on in my country."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Failing to appease my citizens now..."
entries.dialogueText: "Failing to appease my citizens now will lead to mutiny down the line. You know that."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""I hope they behave themselves in f..."
entries.dialogueText: "I hope they behave themselves in front of their King."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""No. It's not what Vina would have..."
entries.dialogueText: "No. It's not what Vina would have wanted."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Not as long as my daughter's lover..."
entries.dialogueText: "Not as long as my daughter's lover is one of the speakers."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Hugo rubbed his forehead."
entries.dialogueText: Hugo rubbed his forehead.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Right. About that...""
entries.dialogueText: "Right. About that..."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "His expression saddened."
entries.dialogueText: His expression saddened.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""I am truly sorry, Romus. But the h..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am truly sorry, Romus. But the hostage situation with Her Highness is all the more reason why..."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A gavel banged."
entries.dialogueText: A gavel banged.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "My uncle watched with a smile as th..."
entries.dialogueText: My uncle watched with a smile as the representatives began filing into the room.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""I think we'll find a lot more supp..."
entries.dialogueText: "I think we'll find a lot more supporters of the Crown since the last time we were here."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""I'm relieved that the RPP's histor..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm relieved that the RPP's historic gains six years ago were a mere anomaly."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""We appease them by winning. Which..."
entries.dialogueText: "We appease them by winning. Which we actually might have a chance at, if we focus and apply ourselves."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""That's what the reports from your..."
entries.dialogueText: "That's what the reports from your Council are for."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Your enemies already have formed t..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your enemies already have formed their opinions about monarchies. Keeping our symbolic parliament open is not going to change them."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Of course, the Delegates' advice i..."
entries.dialogueText: "Of course, the Delegates' advice is invaluable in times of peace. But I just think that..."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Manus Sazon, positioned behind the..."
entries.dialogueText: Manus Sazon, positioned behind the House Speaker podium, carefully put the wooden mallet aside.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Daria de Rava, positioned behind th..."
entries.dialogueText: Daria de Rava, positioned behind the House Speaker podium, put the wooden mallet aside.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "My uncle watched calmly as the repr..."
entries.dialogueText: My uncle watched calmly as the representatives began filing into the room.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""I don't see many fresh faces.""
entries.dialogueText: "I don't see many fresh faces."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""It's a relief that the RPP didn't..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's a relief that the RPP didn't manage to make any gains over last time."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Yes. Phew. What a relief.""
entries.dialogueText: "Yes. Phew. What a relief."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Perhaps Manus Sazon's charisma is..."
entries.dialogueText: "Perhaps Manus Sazon's charisma is wearing off."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""One can only hope.""
entries.dialogueText: "One can only hope."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Unfortunate that our minority spea..."
entries.dialogueText: "Unfortunate that our minority speaker managed to retain his position."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Even if that wasn't the case, I'm..."
entries.dialogueText: "Even if that wasn't the case, I'm under no obligation to take the party's advice."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""That's true. But we don't want the..."
entries.dialogueText: "That's true. But we don't want them getting big ideas."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I wouldn't mind hearing a little m..."
entries.dialogueText: "I wouldn't mind hearing a little more from the opposition."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""As long as Manus Sazon is still mi..."
entries.dialogueText: "As long as Manus Sazon is still minority speaker, you will hear plenty."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""They will if they want to keep the..."
entries.dialogueText: "They will if they want to keep their heads."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Their movement is undeniable now...."
entries.dialogueText: "Their movement is undeniable now. Perhaps we should start listening to them."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Throw them a scrap or two. But we..."
entries.dialogueText: "Throw them a scrap or two. But we can't let them have the whole roast."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""There's over 50 of them. Beheading..."
entries.dialogueText: "There's over 50 of them. Beheading that many politicians would be... well, I would rather not say 'satisfying', but..."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Don't worry about it. The party an..."
entries.dialogueText: "Don't worry about it. The party and I have an understanding."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Actually, that does worry me.""
entries.dialogueText: "Actually, that does worry me."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""If they want to throw a tantrum, I..."
entries.dialogueText: "If they want to throw a tantrum, I'll let them. They still don't have any real power."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Not yet.""
entries.dialogueText: "Not yet."

entries.dialogueText: "We pray for the courage to face our challenges, and the wisdom to choose paths that lead to prosperity and peace for our kingdom."

entries.dialogueText: "God bless this assembly, and God bless our sovereign king."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "Yes, thank you, Grand Wiseman. We will not forget the role of God in these halls."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava

entries.dialogueText: "Remember, we are but one people, watching over this kingdom by the great grace of our God, duty-bound to carry His truths into the mortal realm."

entries.dialogueText: "And the truths of His emissary, your sovereign king."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "Your wisdom is inspiring, Grand Wiseman."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "Until next time, my comrades."

entries.dialogueText: "Thank you, and God bless our troops."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "Thank you, and God bless you all."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I bid you farewell until next time.""
entries.dialogueText: "I bid you farewell until next time."

entries.dialogueText: "Mr. Sazon, see you for dinner at ours next week."

entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I will remind you that we are at w..."
entries.dialogueText: "I will remind you that we are at war. And during a war, you stand behind your king no matter what."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Your wisdom is inspiring, Grand Wi..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your wisdom is inspiring, Grand Wiseman."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Hugo and everyone else in the room..."
entries.dialogueText: Hugo and everyone else in the room repeated the word after me.

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""Hrm. Yes.""
entries.dialogueText: "Hrm. Yes."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I thank you for bringing my attent..."
entries.dialogueText: "I thank you for bringing my attention to the plight of the less fortunate in my kingdom."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I tire of your constant negativity..."
entries.dialogueText: "I tire of your constant negativity. The next time we convene in these chambers, I would like to hear only good news."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The Delegates looked puzzled. A few..."
entries.dialogueText: The Delegates looked puzzled. A few applauded.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Thank you, and God bless you all.""
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you, and God bless you all."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Until next time, my comrades.""
entries.dialogueText: "Until next time, my comrades."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Thank you, and God bless our troop..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you, and God bless our troops."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I bid you farewell until next time.""
entries.dialogueText: "I bid you farewell until next time."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Mr. Sazon, see you for dinner at o..."
entries.dialogueText: "Mr. Sazon, see you for dinner at ours next week."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""It is not my wisdom, but that of t..."
entries.dialogueText: "It is not my wisdom, but that of the heavens above."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Hugo and the Delegates quietly repe..."
entries.dialogueText: Hugo and the Delegates quietly repeated the phrase.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I can serve my people a lot more e..."
entries.dialogueText: "I can serve my people a lot more easily when I am not surrounded by constant disagreement."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Thank you, and Glovurius axa Rizia.""
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you, and Glovurius axa Rizia."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It is my hope that the majority an..."
entries.dialogueText: "It is my hope that the majority and opposition can find common ground. Otherwise, we are all lost."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Hugo and the Delegates repeated the..."
entries.dialogueText: Hugo and the Delegates repeated the phrase.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Manus' face reddened. He nodded and..."
entries.dialogueText: Manus' face reddened. He nodded and left his podium.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The Delegates politely applauded."
entries.dialogueText: The Delegates politely applauded.

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""Glovurius axa Rizia.""
entries.dialogueText: "Glovurius axa Rizia."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I repeated the phrase along with Hu..."
entries.dialogueText: I repeated the phrase along with Hugo and the other Delegates.

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""Then until next time, ladies and g..."
entries.dialogueText: "Then until next time, ladies and gentlemen."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""Unless, of course, His Majesty had..."
entries.dialogueText: "Unless, of course, His Majesty had any closing remarks."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Well. Seems like Rizia is doing be..."
entries.dialogueText: "Well. Seems like Rizia is doing better than ever."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What a waste of time.""
entries.dialogueText: "What a waste of time."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We're screwed, aren't we?""
entries.dialogueText: "We're screwed, aren't we?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""So everybody loves me. That's a re..."
entries.dialogueText: "So everybody loves me. That's a relief."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""To hear the Sazon boy tell it, yes..."
entries.dialogueText: "To hear the Sazon boy tell it, yes. But do you trust him?"

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""I would not put it so crassly.""
entries.dialogueText: "I would not put it so crassly."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Be careful, Your Majesty. You cann..."
entries.dialogueText: "Be careful, Your Majesty. You cannot afford to fall into complacency."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""House of Delegates? More like Hous..."
entries.dialogueText: "House of Delegates? More like House of Irrelevance."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'd better get to work passing dec..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'd better get to work passing decrees."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Apparently, yes.""
entries.dialogueText: "Apparently, yes."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Be careful how much you capitulate..."
entries.dialogueText: "Be careful how much you capitulate to the RPP. Their victory is already getting to Mr. Sazon's head."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""The RNC has some good proposals. B..."
entries.dialogueText: "The RNC has some good proposals. But you needn't give Baroness de Rava everything she is asking for."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Hugo suppressed a laugh."
entries.dialogueText: Hugo suppressed a laugh.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""I keep telling you, Your Majesty...."
entries.dialogueText: "I keep telling you, Your Majesty. Your presence is not required at these sessions."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""To put it mildly.""
entries.dialogueText: "To put it mildly."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Any thoughts on today's session, Y..."
entries.dialogueText: "Any thoughts on today's session, Your Grace?"

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""The Sazon boy is getting overconfi..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Sazon boy is getting overconfident since his election win. I would be careful of how much you capitulate to his party."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He kept his eyes on the Delegates a..."
entries.dialogueText: He kept his eyes on the Delegates as they left the hall.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Having said that... the concerns h..."
entries.dialogueText: "Having said that... the concerns he raised about the public's discontent were valid. We should find a way to mollify them."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""The concerns he raised about publi..."
entries.dialogueText: "The concerns he raised about public discontent were overblown, if you ask me. I would not worry about the state of the nation."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""And I don't trust his assessment o..."
entries.dialogueText: "And I don't trust his assessment of public opinion. The whispers I've been hearing tell a very different story."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Having said that, I do trust his a..."
entries.dialogueText: "Having said that, I do trust his assessment of the public's opinion. It is consistent with what I've been hearing."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Baroness de Rava is handling the H..."
entries.dialogueText: "Baroness de Rava is handling the House as capably as ever. But a certain opposition speaker is getting a little too confident for comfort."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He kept his eyes on the Delegates a..."
entries.dialogueText: He kept his eyes on the Delegates as they left the hall.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He picked up his attache case and p..."
entries.dialogueText: He picked up his attache case and paused to look at me.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Having said that... the concerns r..."
entries.dialogueText: "Having said that... the concerns raised about the public's discontent were valid. We should find a way to mollify them."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""The concerns that were raised abou..."
entries.dialogueText: "The concerns that were raised about public discontent are overblown, if you ask me."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I know. I just felt like a good la..."
entries.dialogueText: "I know. I just felt like a good laugh."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I disagree. The Delegates need to..."
entries.dialogueText: "I disagree. The Delegates need to be reminded whom they answer to."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I was kidding. It's always useful..."
entries.dialogueText: "I was kidding. It's always useful to hear how the public is doing."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You're absolutely right. I should..."
entries.dialogueText: "You're absolutely right. I should listen to you more often."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""As long as you remember that what..."
entries.dialogueText: "As long as you remember that what you're hearing may not reflect the truth."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""You have more pressing priorities..."
entries.dialogueText: "You have more pressing priorities than laughter, Your Majesty..."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Ideally, my presence should serve..."
entries.dialogueText: "Ideally, my presence should serve as that reminder."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""I am your Grand Vizier. Trust me t..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am your Grand Vizier. Trust me to fulfill my function."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""It's been a while since the two of..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's been a while since the two of us caught up. I hope you'll do me the honor of paying me a private visit once you're back from your trip to Derdia."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""If you have something to say to me..."
entries.dialogueText: "If you have something to say to me, you should say it here."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""As long as no wine is involved, I'..."
entries.dialogueText: "As long as no wine is involved, I'd love to."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""As long as wine is involved, I'd l..."
entries.dialogueText: "As long as wine is involved, I'd love to."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""If the Derdians don't kill me? Sur..."
entries.dialogueText: "If the Derdians don't kill me? Sure thing."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""There are some matters that are be..."
entries.dialogueText: "There are some matters that are best kept in the family."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The honor would be all mine, Your..."
entries.dialogueText: "The honor would be all mine, Your Grace."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Hugo rose and bowed."
entries.dialogueText: Hugo rose and bowed.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Until then, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "Until then, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I stayed in my seat until the room..."
entries.dialogueText: I stayed in my seat until the room was completely empty.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Was Manus right? Was my public happ..."
entries.dialogueText: Was Manus right? Was my public happy with my reign?

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "And if he was, where would I go fro..."
entries.dialogueText: And if he was, where would I go from here?

entries.dialogueText: Was Daria right? Was my public happy with my reign?

entries.speaker: Narrator

entries.speaker: Narrator

entries.dialogueText: And if he was, where would I go from here?

entries.dialogueText: Was Daria right? Was my public unhappy with my reign?

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "And if she was, where would I go fr..."
entries.dialogueText: And if she was, where would I go from here?

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I can't promise you anything. Who..."
entries.dialogueText: "I can't promise you anything. Who knows if I'll make it back from Derdia alive."
